prompt: For 0.1 mol/L NaCl treated as fully dissociated monovalent ions, find ionic strength in mol/L.
hint: Use half the sum of c z² for both ions.
explanation: I = ½ Σ c z² = ½ (0.1 × 1² + 0.1 × 1²) = 0.1 mol/L, since Na⁺ and Cl⁻ each have concentration 0.1 and charge magnitude 1.
